visual_logic.surface_detail: Slender, needle-like body with 'Iridescent Violet' and 'Slate' tones; very smooth, small-scale texture.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Emphasis on the 'Saber-Teeth'—two oversized fangs at the front of the jaw that overlap the lower lip.

environment.water: Deep olive-tinted 'Greensand' water with high particulate marine snow.
environment.biota: Distant silhouettes of giant mosasaurs, making the Enchodus look small but scrappy.

visual_logic.pose: Darting through a cloud of bubbles, its body straight as an arrow to emphasize speed and precision.
